bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'VIDEO_POLL_CONTAINER='
docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'VIDEO_POLL_IMAGE='
docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'VIDEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT='
find "$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name creatorWizard.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -n 3 || true
printf 'VIDEO_CURRENT_BRANCH_HEAD='
git ls-remote https://github.com/seigo-gace/create-videobot.git refs/heads/feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core | cut -c1-40
printf 'VIDEO_SOURCE_READY='
docker logs --tail 80 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS|CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED|GATE_OWNER_PUBLIC_POSTING_NOT_CONNECTED' | tail -n 3 || true
echo VIDEO_DIAGNOSTIC_FINISHED=YES
